callouts.text: 1 · Click "pose: Pose" to expand — self-referential, so click the nested "x: Pose" again to go as deep as you like. With the block selected, click any row text (not the chevron, not the blue link) — Source mode opens with the cursor AT THE CLICK. A nested row (e.g. "y: float = 10") jumps to the block that OWNS it (Pose) and lands the cursor on that field’s line, at your click position.

2 · Same engine, prior-art chevron styling. In Source mode, type a type name (e.g. "Po") — the autocomplete popup now paints ON TOP of everything on the canvas: drag an arrow straight through it and the list stays fully readable.

PASS WHEN · Clicking row text opens Source with the cursor at the clicked character (nested rows open the OWNER block’s source, never the row’s own type); the blue link still just jumps; the autocomplete popup is never hidden behind any shape; and a Custom px typed in the Font size menu visibly renders at that exact size on Text shapes AND Code blocks, with presets snapping back.
3 · Type Mapping: click the blue "Pose" token to jump to its real definition above. "Pairs" chains off "Pair", defined earlier in the same block — a mapping can reference its own prior aliases.

4 · Four Code blocks, four different settings. Select any one — ONE shared pill controls language, text size, line numbers, and character width. NEW: the Font size menu has a Custom row under the presets — type any px (say 29) and the text renders at exactly that size; it works the same on a plain Text shape or a sticky note. Clicking a preset snaps cleanly back.
5 · Drag a Code block's corner handle and watch the live "N ch" badge update — width is real and derived from the drag, not just a label. The rightmost block already uses a custom (non-preset) width.
